reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1 skipped (missing-validation finding; function is also an exported Server Action). Gate 2: attack entry point is attacker-controlled HTTP POST formData — not a trusted source; no trust_assumptions defined in scope file. Gate 3: src/app/oauth/authorize/consent/actions.ts is explicitly in scope under src/app/oauth/. An attacker can trigger this via a direct POST to the handleConsent server action (bypassing GET /oauth/authorize redirect_uri validation) by supplying a valid client_id and an arbitrary redirect_uri=https://attacker.com/steal, causing the server to issue a real authorization code and redirect it to the attacker-controlled URI (L106–109), enabling full authorization code interception. Additionally, the deny path (L28–34) is an unauthenticated open redirect — no client_id validation, no redirect_uri allowlist check — reachable by any unauthenticated user.
